subject: Urgent: temporary P1 on-call expansion for peak billing window - PivotalPay
messages:
From: Maya Lopez <maya.lopez@pivotalpay.com>
To: support@redwoodinference.com
Cc: ops@pivotalpay.com
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 23:12:00 -0700
Subject: [PivotalPay] Request: temporary P1 on-call expansion for peak billing window

Hi Redwood team,

We saw a repeat of the latency-related P1 incidents during our nightly billing cutoff window last night (23:00-01:00 PT). Several tokenized billing jobs spiked and retries pushed our downstream systems into a throttle loop — internal ops had to pause the pipeline for ~18 minutes. This is the third occurrence in the last two weeks.

We'd like to request a temporary expansion of your P1 on-call coverage for the next 7 nights to ensure there is redundant human coverage and a clear escalation path at 00:00-06:00 PT while we work through load smoothing. Specifically:
- Add an additional on-call engineer for nights (overlap 00:00–04:00 PT)
- Confirm an escalation path that includes a beeline to an engineering on-call (not just support) for infra/runtime regressions
- Share short-term mitigations (routing, burst capacity, model variant fallback) you can implement immediately

Attached is a short analysis from our side (pivotalpay_peak_analysis.pdf) and sample windows. We appreciate a quick confirmation and proposed action items by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Maya Lopez
Sr. SRE, PivotalPay
Attachments: pivotalpay_peak_analysis.pdf

From: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
To: grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Cc: maya.lopez@pivotalpay.com
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 08:09:00 -0700
Subject: RE: [PivotalPay] Request: temporary P1 on-call expansion for peak billing window

Thanks Maya — and noted. Grace / Karthik: tagging you both to triage and propose a short-term carve-in plan.

Initial read: the symptoms line up with momentary queue congestion + model variant tail latency during long sequences in the billing jobs. We have a couple of levers we can flip quickly:
1) Temporary overlap on P1 roster (add shadow for midnight-04:00 PT)
2) Enable automatic model-variant fallback (lower-latency quantized variant) for the billing route with a limit on tokens per request
3) Short-term capacity burst (enable Dedicated burst or increase TPU pool quota for these nightly windows)

Questions for Maya: are your billing requests single-shot generation calls (single large prompt) or a stream of shorter prompts? That will change batching strategy.

Karthik — can you draft an on-call rota change and a fallback gating rule? Grace — can you confirm SLA credit triggers if we still miss the window and whether PivotalPay expects retrospective postmortem?

I'll hold on external comms until we have a concrete ops plan.

Jonas Weber
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Cc: maya.lopez@pivotalpay.com
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 07:21:00 -0700
Subject: RE: [PivotalPay] Request: temporary P1 on-call expansion for peak billing window

Hi team,

Thanks for the details — Maya, sorry you hit this repeatedly. I'm proposing a short, actionable plan we can implement tonight and run for the next 7 nights while we work on longer-term smoothing:

Immediate actions (within 4 hours):
- Rota: add a second P1 shadow for 00:00–04:00 PT for the next 7 nights (oncall roster attached: proposed_oncall_rota.xlsx)
- Routing fallback: enable model-variant fallback for the /generate-billing route to the quantized v1-lowlat model when queue depth > 50 or median latency > 450ms
- Burst capacity: provision +20% reserved burst for your tenant for 00:00–02:00 PT for the next 3 nights; will extend if signal shows need
- Escalation path: immediate pager escalation to oncall infra (karthik) + support lead (grace) documented in the new escalation playbook entry

Telemetry & guardrails:
- We will add a short-lived metric (billing.cutoff_tail_latency) to your dashboard and open a shared alert that pages at 95th percentile > 800ms for 5m
- If we hit two P1 incidents in a 24h period after mitigations, we will schedule an immediate postmortem and extend the rota until root cause is addressed

SLA/Credits:
- Per our enterprise terms, if we fail agreed P1 response/mitigation windows twice in 30 days, you're eligible for service credits. We will proactively waive paperwork for this temporary carve-in unless the prevention plan is rejected.

Next steps I propose:
1) Karthik applies rota change + routing rule (I estimate 90–120m to fully validate)
2) Jonas sends a short note to PivotalPay confirming hours & escalation names once rota is in place
3) We run nightly and sync Tuesday after the 7 nights with a short postmortem

Karthik — can you push the rota and the routing gating rule? I'll stand by to validate telemetry.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Support, Redwood Inference
Attachments: proposed_oncall_rota.xlsx

From: Maya Lopez <maya.lopez@pivotalpay.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com, grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 27 Aug 2026 09:33:00 -0700
Subject: RE: [PivotalPay] Request: temporary P1 on-call expansion for peak billing window

Grace / Jonas / Karthik — thank you, this sounds good and we appreciate the quick plan.

Confirming acceptance for the 7-night experiment and the proposed overlap 00:00–04:00 PT. We approve the temporary quantized fallback and the +20% burst for initial nights. Please copy our SRE rotation (ops@pivotalpay.com) into the pager escalation and send over the updated escalation playbook and the DocuSign envelope for the temporary amendment (if you prefer formal sign-off).

Also: can you add a weekly 15m checkpoint during the experiment (Mon mornings) to share early signals? Our ops lead (I cc'd ops@pivotalpay.com) will join.

Appreciate the rapid response.

—Maya
Sr. SRE, PivotalPay

> On Wed, 26 Aug 2026 at 07:21:00 -0700 Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
